thread:
Maya_CS: quick thread from today's account health review. pulled together customer asks + renewal concerns. short version: 5 feature asks, 2 mid-contract risks.

Maya_CS: customers in scope: CardioPlus (enterprise), MetroRetail (pilot), BlueArc (trial). notes copied below.

Maya_CS: 1) Invoice line-item clarity 12: CardioPlus sees token-level line-items split by route and it's confusing finance team. they want consolidated invoice option and clearer labels (model, route, tokens).

Diego_AM: CardioPlus is in Q2 renewal window. billing ambiguity is main blocker to sign-off, they want a sample invoice before renewal meeting.

Maya_CS: 2) Self-serve seat admin + SCIM scaffold 12: MetroRetail is scaling pilots, asking for ability to assign seats by team and SCIM scaffolding (they can provide IdP metadata).

Priya_PM: SCIM is on our roadmap but not QA'd. can we offer a short-term workaround (auto-invite CSV + seat expiry)?

Maya_CS: 3) Embedding model pinning per-project 12: BlueArc reported drift when we auto-roll embeddings. they want ability to pin to a specific model hash/version at project level.

Sam_RE: note: this intersects with optimize team. pinning feature could be a UI toggle + immutable version field in project config.

Maya_CS: 4) Webhook retry/backoff telemetry 12: customers want visibility and more robust retries when webhooks 408/502. request: retry policy config + retry logs in Console.

Oliver_Eng: retry policy should be safe; we'll need idempotency guidance in docs. feasible as P1.

Maya_CS: 5) Admin audit logs for Private deployment 12: CardioPlus's security team asked for tamper-evident admin logs (integrate with S3 audit archive or syslog).

Rachel_CSLead: security ask is a must for renewal. call out as P0.

Diego_AM: prioritization ask: which of the 5 are urgent to de-risk renewals? my take: Invoice clarity (CardioPlus) = P0, Admin audit logs = P0, SCIM scaffold = P1, Embedding pinning = P1, Webhook telemetry = P2.

Priya_PM: agree. action items:
- Priya_PM: raise epic "CS Billing & Security: renewal de-risk" and assign owners.
- Oliver_Eng: scope invoice consolidation workstream and estimate EOW.
- Sam_RE: draft product note for embedding pinning and tradeoffs.
- Maya_CS / Diego_AM: request sample invoice template from CardioPlus finance by Tue.

triage-bot: created ticket RED-5217 in backlog (labels: cs-feedback, billing, security).

Oliver_Eng: quick follow-up Q on invoice consolidation: do customers want historical rewrites or just new invoices moving forward?

Maya_CS: CardioPlus asked for both: sample consolidated invoice for last 30 days and new consolidated format going forward. historical rewrite can be manual export if needed.

Priya_PM: for SCIM scaffold, propose customer-facing doc + CSV fallback. will draft and share link.

Sam_RE: embedding pinning: will prototype a project-level "model_lock" boolean that prevents auto-roll. posting design doc in RED-5218.

Diego_AM: scheduling: CardioPlus renewal meeting Fri 11am PT 12 Maya and Rachel attending. need invoice sample before Thu EOD.

Rachel_CSLead: adding renewal tracker flag. will escalate if we don't have a sample invoice by Wed afternoon.

Maya_CS: thanks team. marking this thread as the capture point for these asks. I'll update RED-5217 with meeting notes and link design docs when available.

triage-bot: note: issue RED-5217 updated with priority labels at 2149000860.

Priya_PM: wrapping up: if anyone wants to take ownership of the audit-logs P0, DM me. security owners preferred.

Oliver_Eng: pairing with security infra for audit logs. will volunteer as tech owner.

Maya_CS: perfect 12 closing thread for now, will reopen if any blockers appear before the CardioPlus renewal.
